item.tib: rgyal kun spyi gzugs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las bsnyen sgrub skabs kyi phrin las 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod
item.coloph: ces bon sgo theg pa rim dgu'i yang snying*/ gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams (rnam) bzhi'i dgongs don bcud du dril ba/ gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs dgongs pa'i cha lag skabs kyi phrin las 'di ni/ gshen bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mdo 'dzin khod spung (spungs) dran pa nam mkhas dgongs pa'i klong du rgyas gdab pa de nyid/ slar smon lam gyi mthu las sngon sbyang gi las 'phro sad nas/ lha dang bla ma'i bka' yis gnang ba bzhin/ smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa bdag gis bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas brda don shugs 'byung du yig ger bkod pa 'dis kyang snyig (snyigs) ma'i rgud pa zhi zhing rgyal bstan srid mthar gnas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
